questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of Parseval Theorem?
questions.answer: Parseval theorem says the total squared size of a periodic function equals the total squared size of its Fourier coefficients. In physics this connects signal energy or wave power to harmonic amplitudes.

questions.prompt: State a central formula or test for Parseval Theorem.
questions.answer:
The parseval theorem is
\[\frac{1}{\pi}\int_{-\pi}^{\pi}|f(x)|^2\,dx=\frac{a_0^2}{2}+\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}(a_n^2+b_n^2)\]
